text:
Marin: Pushed a new dark theme sample (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/inkwell-refresh. Key changes: neutral-ink base (#050607), marginally warmer cards (#0B0C0D), and a compact accent ramp. Can the team quickly scan legends, tiny counters, sparklines, and code blocks for legibility?
Sal: Quick glance: 8px counters are borderline for contrast on the card surface. Either bump to 10px min or add a semi-opaque inner backdrop.
Ivy: For tiny counters I'd prefer min-height 10px + slight padding. Backdrop feels like a hack and can cause visual weight inconsistencies.
Derek: Noted. On sparklines: 1px strokes disappear on 1x displays. Propose adding a faint outer stroke using panel-contrast color (opacity ~0.92) for thumbnails only.
Marin: I'll prototype sparklines with an outline on 1x: `stroke-opacity:0.94; stroke-width:1.25;` and an outer outline `stroke:#0A0A0A; stroke-width:0.5;`.
Nora: Accessibility: stacked bars using the current accent ramp are too similar for deuteranopia. Suggest moving to a perceptual ramp with larger L* deltas and keeping hue shifts subtle.
Sal: +1. Also inline code in comments is faint. Could we do a border-left accent instead of filled chips? Example CSS: `.inline-code{border-left:2px solid var(--accent-500); padding-left:6px; background:transparent;}`
Ivy: That preserves context and helps legibility without adding strong blocks of color in text flows. Love it.
Derek: Microcopy: tooltips use both "units" and "tokens" across the Console. Let's standardize to "tokens" and update localization keys.
Marin: Will standardize to "tokens". Also thinking about focus states: keyboard focus on interactive rows is subtle. I'll test `outline:3px solid rgba(97,167,255,0.95); outline-offset:4px;` for 3:1 perceptibility.
Nora: For enterprise accessibility, can we add a per-user "Chart contrast" toggle in Advanced Settings? Some customers want bolder charts without changing the entire theme.
Sal: Per-user toggle is ideal. Keep it off by default and remember preference in user profile.
Marin: Good. I'll add a small control in the prototype. If everyone is okay with the Lab-based ramp and the inline-code border trick, I'll cut a token PR today.
Design-Bot: Design review created: DR-4589 - "Inkwell refresh: counters, sparklines, and a11y ramp" assigned to @Marin. Comments due in 48h.
Ivy: Leaving Figma comments on the counter size examples.
Derek: I'll run Axe contrast on the updated tokens once the PR lands.
Marin: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" I'll post the token diff + tiny changelog later today.
